front: Khái niệm 'Comparative vs. Superlative Adjectives' trong Unit 7: Viet Nam and International Organisations được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Comparatives compare 2 entities (short adj + -er + than / more + long adj + than). Superlatives compare 1 against a whole group (the + short adj + -est / the most + long adj).

💡 Ví dụ: Viet Nam is becoming more active in peacekeeping missions. It is one of the most dynamic economies in Southeast Asia.
🌱 Bản chất: Degrees of quality across relative benchmarks.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Irregular Adjectives'?
back:
good -> better -> the best; bad -> worse -> the worst; far -> farther/further -> the farthest/furthest.

📝 Ví dụ: Cooperation leads to better economic growth than trade barriers.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Historical etymology preserves suppletive comparative forms.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Complete: 'Joining international trade organizations has made our economy much (competitive) than before.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: 'competitive' is a long adjective (4 syllables).
Step 2: 'than' signals comparative degree => use 'more competitive'.

👉 Kết luận: more competitive

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Double comparison: writing 'more better' or 'the most easiest'.?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Double comparison: writing 'more better' or 'the most easiest'.

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: Never use 'more' with -er adjectives, or 'most' with -est adjectives.
